pages.title: Starting
pages.text: $(li)Close the hatch and let the Vacuum Port pump the channel below 5%$(li)Cooldown: 20 kW for 2 minutes, or 1 minute with vacuum outside$(li)Ignition: 150 kW for 10 s$(li)Then it sustains itself

pages.title: Burning
pages.text: Drive sets the burn, up to 100%. Load-follow matches your grid's demand.$(br2)Keep the Vacuum Port on $(bold)Pump$(); using it switches to Vent. On Vent, helium ash smothers the plasma within a minute.

pages.title: Stopping
pages.text: $(bold)Stop$() closes the fuel valve and ramps the burn down over 20 s, with no wear.$(br2)$(bold)E-Stop$(), held for a second, or a redstone signal ends the plasma at once: a disruption.

pages.title: Disruptions
pages.text: Magnet power lost, the loop over 1,100°C, no fuel, the hatch opened, the shell broken, the channel losing vacuum, or a redstone signal.$(br2)Each adds 5% wear to every First Wall block. Replace worn blocks to repair them; above 80% it will not ignite.

pages.title: Mitigation
pages.text: Turning disruption mitigation off unlocks drive up to 150%. The hotter loop converts more, but every second above 100% wears the First Wall.$(br2)$(danger)Without it, a loop over 1,100°C melts the whole First Wall through to magma.$()
